title: Crunchyroll Goes All Out at Anime Expo 2026 With Solo Leveling Movie, Ghost of Tsushima: Legends First Look, and More

title: Crunchyroll Shares New Look at Ghost of Tsushima Anime (And It Might Not Be What You Expect)
content: Ghost of Tsushima became a major part of PlayStation’s exclusive library, presenting gamers with a jaw-dropping open-world environment that warranted a sequel. Last year, Ghost of Yotei took the ball from Tsushima and introduced a similar environment with a new protagonist in the lead.
author: ComicBook

title: Disney’s Coolest New Animated Series Confirms Season 2 Return With First Look
content: Disney’s coolest new animated series has confirmed that a new season is now in the works for a launch next year, so it’s the perfect time to catch up. It’s been a notable year for Disney Television Animation as fans have seen a few new animated series making their respective debuts over the last few months .
author: ComicBook

title: 'Kininatteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, Opening Theme, Teaser Promo for Winter 2027
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase panel at Anime Expo 2026 revealed the main cast, staff, opening theme, a teaser visual (pictured), and a teaser promotional video for the television anime adaptation of Sumiko Arai 's Kininatteru Hito ga Otoko ja Nakatta ( The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn't a Guy at All ) manga on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends Anime Reveals New Character Visuals
content: Ghost of Tsushima: Legends anime revealed new character visuals ahead of its 2027 release date. The announcement was made by Crunchyroll during its showcase at Anime Expo 2026. title: 'Ore dake Level Up na Ken' Gets Sequel Movie
content: The Crunchyroll Showcase at Anime Expo 2026 announced a sequel movie titled Beyond the System titled Beyond the System for the Ore dake Level Up na Ken ( Solo Leveling ) anime series on Friday. It revealed a teaser visual (pictured) and a teaser trailer.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Major Crunchyroll Isekai Confirms Season 5 Return With New Trailer – Watch Now
content: A major Isekai franchise has confirmed it’s coming back to Crunchyroll next year with a brand new season, and the anime has given fans a whole new look at Season 5 with a first trailer. Crunchyroll has plenty of new Isekai that fans are going to keep an eye out for through the rest of the year , but that’s not all.
author: ComicBook

title: Fate Rewinder Anime New Trailer, Key Visual and April 2027 Release Date Revealed
content: Fate Rewinder anime film by studio Bones Film revealed a new teaser trailer and key visual, along with an April 2027 release date. Rie Matsumoto, whose previous direction credits include Kyosogiga (2013) and Blood Blockade Battlefront ( Kekkai Sensen , 2015), directs the new anime.
author: Anime Corner

title: Solo Leveling Series Gets Solo Leveling: Beyond the System Anime Film
content: Crunchyroll announced during its panel at Anime Expo on Friday that the Solo Leveling series is getting an anime film titled Solo Leveling : Beyond the System . The film, which continues the story after the second season, is currently in production.
author: ANN
